content.short: The fiat-backed stablecoin of the Cardano ecosystem. Powering the fully stable branch of Cardano.
content.description: Shareslake is the fully stable branch of the Cardano ecosystem. It opens the Cardano technology to all those use cases where volatility is not an option. They created the usd-backed Redeemable stablecoin, the first stablecoin in Cardano mainnet which also powers the Shareslake network, a Cardano-based network fully connected to Cardano mainnet through the Shareslake bridge.
